hints.title: Dimension Independence
hints.text: The row ordering and column ordering are completely independent and can be solved as two separate dependency problems.

hints.title: Topological Order Extraction
hints.text: Build directed graphs for both row conditions and column conditions. Use in-degree based topological sorting to find valid coordinate sequences.

hints.title: Cycle Detection and Grid Placement
hints.text: If either graph contains a cycle (fewer than k elements ordered), return an empty matrix. Otherwise, place each number at its corresponding row and column indices.

hints.title: Topological Matrix Construction Implementation

variables: k: matrix dimensions and number count
complexity.notes: Linear topological sort over condition graphs followed by k x k grid assignment.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trial-and-error permutations over k elements results in factorial complexity O(k!).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores adjacency lists and position maps for direct O(1) grid placement.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that row and column constraints decouple cleanly into two independent topological sorts.
